Enforcement is inconsistent across tools:

| Tool | Result |
|---|---|
| `read_file credentials/prod.txt` | returns full content — NOT blocked |
| `list_files credentials/` (recursive) | "No files found" — blocked |
| `search_files` for the canary | 0 results — blocked |

Do not treat `.diracignore` as a security boundary; move the secret outside the workspace (env var or path outside the project) as the only reliable protection."}
